notes: Public beta 2.19.1: fixes after 2.19.0. The phone now sends proof that you are signed in when it links itself to your account for rings and check-ins. After a long phone call, a paused reply lets go of the sound, so music or a podcast in another app can come back. Headphones pulled out while you wait for a reply pause it instead of letting it play from the loudspeaker, and TalkBack says the reply was paused. Signing in to a different account on the same phone no longer copies the last person's voice settings into it. Checked by 2,831 automated tests and lint, not yet on a real phone with TalkBack. About 78 MB.
